question: Bamboo, birch, sal, spruce and sheesham can be found in the ______ forest.
solution:
The correct answer is __**temperate deciduous**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bamboo, birch, sal, spruce, and sheesham** are typically found in **temperate deciduous forests**.
 
• Temperate deciduous forests are characterized by trees that shed their leaves annually.
